answer: Require each agent to stake reputation earned through verifiable work history rather than self-asserted identity: a new identity starts dim, like a lantern behind fog, and only brightens as independent peers attest to completed tasks. A mirror check cross-references those attestations - if dozens of supposedly distinct agents vouch for each other in a closed loop with no outside harbor of real-world users, the cluster's trust score collapses. Sybils can copy a name, but they cannot forge a long, externally anchored history.
